verbatim_quote: Nebraska economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Total retail sales made to customers in the state, exempt sales, services (taxable and exempt), sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: Sales for resale, sublease, or subrent. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: April 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: Nevada economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Gross revenue from retail sales of tangible personal property into the state, exempt sales, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: Sales for resale, services (taxable and exempt). Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: October 1, 2018.

verbatim_quote: New Jersey economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Gross revenue from retail sales of tangible personal property into the state, specified digital products, taxable services (listed in N.J.S.A. 54:32B-3(b)) delivered into the state even if exempt, nontaxable retail sales of tangible personal property, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: Exempt services. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: November 1, 2018.

verbatim_quote: New Mexico economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Total taxable gross receipts from sales, leases, and licenses of tangible personal property, sales from licenses and services for use of real property, digital products and SaaS, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: Exempt sales, exempt services. Evaluation period: Previous calendar year. Effective date: July 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: New York economic nexus threshold: $500,000 and 100 transactions
notes: Included: Cumulative total gross receipts from sales of tangible personal property delivered into the state, SaaS (counts as tangible personal property), nontaxable retail sales of tangible personal property, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: Services (taxable and exempt). Evaluation period: Immediately preceding four sales tax quarters. Effective date: June 21, 2018. Note: Both revenue AND transaction thresholds must be met (and).

verbatim_quote: North Carolina economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Gross sales sourced to the state, sum total sales price of tangible personal property, sum total sales price of digital property, sum total sales price of services, exempt sales, exempt services, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: None. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: November 1, 2018. Previous threshold rules: Sales or transaction volume prior to July 1, 2024.

verbatim_quote: North Dakota economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Gross taxable sales of tangible personal property and other items into the state, gross taxable sales of services into the state. Excluded: Exempt sales, exempt services, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: October 1, 2018. Previous threshold rules: Sales or transactions included prior to July 1, 2019; $100,000 in sales or 200 transactions prior to January 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: Ohio economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Gross receipts from sales of tangible personal property for storage, use, or consumption in the state, enumerated services the benefit of which is realized in the state, exempt sales, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: Sales for resale, exempt services. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: August 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: Oklahoma economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Aggregate sales of taxable tangible personal property, taxable services. Excluded: Exempt sales, exempt services, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: August 1, 2019. Previous threshold rules: $10,000 in aggregate sales of taxable TPP over the preceding 12 calendar months from July 1, 2018, through October 31, 2019; taxable and exempt services excluded from threshold prior to November 1, 2023.

verbatim_quote: Pennsylvania economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Gross sales of products and services in the commonwealth, sales by agents/representatives/subsidiaries in the commonwealth, exempt sales, exempt services, sales made through a marketplace facilitator that does not collect sales tax on behalf of a remote seller. Excluded: Sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator that collects sales tax on behalf of a remote seller. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: July 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: Puerto Rico economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Total gross sales delivered into the territory, exempt sales, services (taxable and exempt). Excluded: Sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Evaluation period: Seller's accounting year. Effective date: January 1, 2021.

verbatim_quote: Rhode Island economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Gross revenue from sales of tangible personal property, prewritten computer software delivered electronically, load and leave/vendor-hosted prewritten computer software, specified digital products, taxable services delivered into the state, exempt sales, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: Exempt services. Evaluation period: Previous calendar year. Effective date: July 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: South Carolina economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Gross revenue from sales of tangible personal property, electronically transferred products, services (taxable and exempt) rendered in the state, exempt sales, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: None. Evaluation period: Previous or current calendar year. Effective date: November 1, 2018.

verbatim_quote: South Dakota economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Gross revenue from sales of tangible personal property, electronically transferred products, services (taxable and exempt) rendered in the state, exempt sales, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: None. Evaluation period: Previous or current calendar year. Effective date: November 1, 2018. Previous threshold rules: $100,000 in sales or 200 transactions prior to July 1, 2023.

verbatim_quote: Tennessee economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Sales to customers in the state, exempt sales, services (taxable and exempt). Excluded: Sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator, sales for resale. Evaluation period: Previous 12-month period. Effective date: July 1, 2019. Previous threshold rules: $500,000 in sales only prior to October 1, 2020; marketplace sales included prior to October 1, 2020.

verbatim_quote: Texas economic nexus threshold: $500,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Gross revenue from sales of tangible personal property and services into the state, exempt sales, exempt services, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: None. Evaluation period: Previous 12-month period. Effective date: July 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: Utah economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Gross revenue from sales of tangible personal property and services into the state, any product transferred electronically into the state, services (taxable and exempt) rendered in the state, exempt sales. Excluded: Sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: January 1, 2019. Previous threshold rules: $100,000 in sales or 200 transactions prior to July 1, 2025.

verbatim_quote: Vermont economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Sales of tangible personal property and services into the state, products transferred electronically, services (taxable and exempt) in the state, exempt sales, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: None. Evaluation period: Previous 12-month period. Effective date: July 1, 2018. Note: Businesses that only sell tax-exempt items into Vermont are not required to register for sales tax.

verbatim_quote: Virginia economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Sales of tangible personal property, products transferred electronically, taxable services, exempt sales. Excluded: Sales for resale, exempt services, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: July 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: Washington economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Cumulative gross annual income, exempt sales, services (taxable and exempt), sales for resale, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: None. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: October 1, 2018. Previous threshold rules: Cumulative gross receipts from retail sales and taxable services into the state prior to December 31, 2019; cumulative gross annual income as of January 1, 2020; resales included as of January 1, 2020.

verbatim_quote: Washington, D.C., economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Gross receipts from retail sales delivered into the district, exempt sales, taxable services, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: Exempt services, sales for resale. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: January 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: West Virginia economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or 200 transactions
notes: Included: Gross sales of tangible personal property and services into the state, exempt sales, exempt services, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: None. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: January 1, 2019.

verbatim_quote: Wisconsin economic nexus threshold: $100,000 in sales only
notes: Included: Annual gross sales of tangible personal property into the state, annual gross sales of services (taxable and exempt) into the state, exempt sales, sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Excluded: None. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: October 1, 2018. Note: Businesses that make only nontaxable sales into Wisconsin are not required to register for sales tax. Previous threshold rules: $100,000 in sales or 200 transactions prior to February 20, 2021.

verbatim_quote: Wyoming economic nexus threshold: $100,000  in sales only
notes: Included: Annual gross sales of tangible personal property into the state, annual gross sales of services (taxable and exempt) into the state, annual gross sales of admission into the state, taxable/exempt/wholesale sales, exempt sales. Excluded: Sales made through a registered marketplace facilitator. Evaluation period: Current or previous calendar year. Effective date: February 1, 2019. Previous threshold rules: $100,000 in sales or 200 transactions prior to July 1, 2024.
